signal_cutoff: 17:00 America/New_York after the named trading session; retrospective date proxy until bar availability is verified
execution_reference: next regular-session open after signal cutoff; use only verified action-adjusted returns for outcome labels
boundary_rule: exclude any outcome window crossing a split boundary
strict_news_availability: requires proven historical first-available time and source version
date_proxy: separate development group; official announcement date then one complete US regular trading session before use; not proof of actual historical visibility
event_dedup: issuer document, attachments and same-origin reprints share event_group_id; independent provenance retained

feature_definitions.tone: source-supported directional wording by entity; missing when not validated
feature_definitions.uncertainty: source-supported uncertainty cue; missing when not validated
feature_definitions.news_count: distinct eligible event groups available before cutoff; null when source coverage unknown
feature_definitions.novelty: new information relative to prior eligible event groups; null without adequate prior archive
feature_definitions.price_control: unadjusted same-session close/open ratio and volume from saved historical bars; retrospective availability caveat

candidate_model: regularized linear; train-only fitting and selection, no fit until qualified coverage
evaluation: cross-sectional Pearson IC, Spearman Rank IC, daily valid n, coverage, date-block intervals only when sufficient cross-section and qualified labels
known_exposure: 2026-04 to 2026-05 validation repeatedly used; 2026-06 to 2026-07 test labels previously viewed; no independent test claim
